parameters.excerpt: For each ``x``INH bit, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.reasoning: Each xINH bit (MINH, SINH, UINH, VSINH, VUINH) in mhpmevent is read-only zero when the associated privilege mode is not implemented. This is a per-bit RO/RW choice depending on which privilege modes are implemented — a NORM_CSR_RW parameter controlling which INH bits are writable vs. read-only-zero.
